projects.title: Ventura
projects.description: • AI-powered community Q&A platform that matches queries to existing discussions, preventing duplicates.• Built semantic search using FastEmbed, achieving 92%+ similarity accuracy in matching queries to existing discussions. • Developed full-stack application with React frontend and Gemini API integration, supporting real-time community threads with social media-style interactions.• Designed PostgreSQL schema with optimized indexing for fast semantic search queries.• Won first place at a hackathon for Overdrive (Optimization) track by demonstrating working prototype to judges in 24 hours.

projects.title: iPrep
projects.description: • AI career coaching platform that analyzes resumes and identifies skill gaps for job seekers• Secured $4,000 in seed funding through university pitch competition by demonstrating product-market fit for AI career development platform. • Led technical prototyping with LLMs, implementing testing frameworks that improved response accuracy by 40% through iterative evaluation.• Conducted 30+ user interviews to validate pain points, resulting in pivot from generic career advice to skill gap analysis for specific job targets.

projects.title: Algorithm in Graph Edge Coloring
projects.description: • Implemented Vizing’s Theorem in Python to ensure distinct edge colors at each vertex through optimized data structures and memory-efficient design using Python slots• Awarded the Honors Fellowship, a $1,500 grant from the Honors College

projects.title: Greek Letters Book Project
projects.description: •Interpreted the connections with astronomy, identifying relevant documents or object, and configuring them into a format that correlates with the written text•Collaborated with Professor Carlsmith and the author to organize his personal book on Greek Letters

projects.title: Stock Market Technical Indicator Project
projects.description: •Delivered valuable insights on trends, market volatility, and potential entry or exit points.•Developed an improved version of the Chandelier Exit indicator by integrating Exponential Moving Average (EMA) and Average True Range (ATR) using a programming language called PineScript on TradingView.•Empowered traders with enhanced market analysis, enabling them to make more informed trading decisions.

projects.title: Aerodynamics Wing Spoilers Research
projects.description: •Constructed a specialized contraction cone to connect a 25-mph fan to the wind tunnel and designed three wing spoilers with varying independent variables using CAD software for comparative analysis.•Conducted data collection to examine lift characteristics and perform lift calculations, while investigating diverse spoiler configurations to analyze their impact on airflow patterns.•Aimed to optimize wing spoiler designs, enhancing overall aircraft performance and efficiency.

projects.title: The Art Day Project
projects.description: Hosted an art event for the Boys and Girls club community by providing the resources for an opportunity to explore and continue their interests in creative arts.

projects.title: The Exploration of Exoplanets
projects.description: •Conducted astronomical research on exoplanets with Dr. Allison Bieryla, collaborating on the TESS project, a space-based NASA satellite mission led by MIT and Harvard. •Extracted data to contribute to the all-sky survey, monitoring thousands of stars for potential transiting exoplanets through a software called AstroImageJ.•Examined dips in brightness that indicate the presence of exoplanets.
